definitions.explanation: Eating meat, or the practice of eating meat. Used both for animals (carnivorous) and humans (meat-eating diet).
Slang describing someone who is aggressive or proactive in pursuing romantic or sexual relationships. Contrasted with {草食|そうしょく} (herbivore), which describes passive, unassertive people.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライオン→ライオン：05197_raion⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肉食|にくしょく}⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧だ。
{肉食|にくしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧にした。
examples.english: I cut back on meat and switched to a vegetable-based diet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恐竜|きょうりゅう}→恐竜：10428_kyouryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肉食|にくしょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{草食|そうしょく}→草食：20954_soushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧がいたこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{分|わ}かっている→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: It is known from fossils that there were both carnivorous and herbivorous dinosaurs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{声|こえ}をかける→声をかける：30589_koewokakeru⟧。
examples.english: He's the aggressive type, so he'll approach someone right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい}⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It's said that assertive women have been increasing recently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{草食|そうしょく}{系|けい}→草食系：27138_soushokukei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ようになってきた。
examples.english: While passive men are on the rise, assertive women have also become more noticeable.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 became widespread around the late 2000s as part of the ⟦{草食|そうしょく}{系|けい}→草食系：27138_soushokukei⟧/{肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい} typology used to describe dating attitudes. The contrast is: {肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい} = aggressive, proactive; ⟦{草食|そうしょく}{系|けい}→草食系：27138_soushokukei⟧ = passive, uninterested.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉食|にくしょく}⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧ (carnivore, meat-eating animal)
- {肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい} (aggressive type, carnivore type)
- {肉食|にくしょく}{系|けい}⟦{男子|だんし}→男子：03425_danshi⟧/⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧ (assertive man/woman)
- {肉食|にくしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧ (cut back on meat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{草食|そうしょく}→草食：20954_soushoku⟧: herbivorous; passive/unassertive (in dating context)
